title: Chilfa bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned at the beginning of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 16: he and Rabbi Chiyya [bar Abba] spoke in Rabbi Yose’s name. In Eichah Rabbah 4:18 the statement appears with changes.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The bracketed [bar Abba] is already a supplement in the supplied Hebrew. The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Vayikra Rabbah 16:1 has Rabbi Chiyya and Chilfa bar Idi in Rabbi Yose’s name, without that patronymic at the matching clause.

The corresponding passage in the consulted Eichah Rabbah 4:18 has Rabbi Berekhya and Chalafi bar Zevid in Rabbi Issi’s name, beside the different names in Vayikra Rabbah; these are not silently identified.
